key_concepts: Force can change the shape of materials
Bending, cutting, crumpling, stretching, and pounding can change shape
Force can change the size of objects
Cutting, grinding, dropping, sharpening, and pounding can change size
Pushing or pulling can set an object into motion
A stationary ball moves when a force is applied
Greater mass requires greater force to move
A table requires greater force to move than a chair
Stronger force makes a toy car move farther
Harder pull stretches a rubber band longer
Force affects the movement of objects
